recognize_zh: 脾臟低倍免疫染色，陽性訊號密集集中在數個白髓濾泡，紅髓內只有零星陽性細胞，呈現B細胞標記的分布模式；抗體名稱未標示，需對照同案H&E與其他染色解讀。
features: Low-power splenic section with dense positive staining localized to rounded white pulp follicles
Scattered individual positive cells in the expanded red pulp
Large areas of red pulp largely negative, suggesting the infiltrate is composed of another population
Central arterioles visible within positive follicles
Chromogen appears dark purple; specific antibody not labeled
describe_en: Immunostained section of spleen at low power shows strong positivity concentrated in the white pulp follicles, with only scattered positive cells in the red pulp. The pattern suggests a B-cell marker (e.g., CD20) highlighting preserved follicles, while the expanded red pulp infiltrate is largely negative. The specific antibody is not stated, so interpretation is limited. In the context of ruptured spleen from infectious mononucleosis, this pattern would support a polymorphous, predominantly non-B red pulp expansion rather than a diffuse B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving spleen
ddx.vs: DLBCL shows sheets or nodules of large B-cells diffusely positive for CD20, not staining confined to preserved follicles.
SMZL shows expanded CD20-positive nodules with marginal zone hyperplasia and intrasinusoidal B-cell infiltration of the red pulp.
